fields.name: BGMI (India)
fields.description: A battle royale shooter where 100 players parachute onto an island, scavenge for weapons and gear, and fight to be the last person or team standing. Features realistic gunplay, vehicles, and multiple maps.

fields.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake
fields.description: A reimagining of the classic 1997 RPG, featuring updated graphics, real-time combat, and an expanded story set in the dystopian city of Midgar.

fields.name: Apex Legends Mobile
fields.description: A free-to-play battle royale hero shooter set in the Titanfall universe, featuring unique characters (Legends) with special abilities.

fields.name: Apex Legends
fields.description: A free-to-play battle royale hero shooter set in the Titanfall universe, featuring unique characters (Legends) with special abilities.

fields.name: Need for Speed Heat
fields.description: A street racing game where players compete in illegal races by night while evading the police, and participate in sanctioned events by day.

fields.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
fields.description: An open-world RPG following Geralt of Rivia as he searches for his adopted daughter, Ciri, while battling monsters and navigating political intrigue.

fields.name: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla
fields.description: An action RPG set in the Viking Age, where players control Eivor, a Norse raider leading their clan to settle in England. Features brutal combat and settlement-building.

fields.name: Fortnite Mobile
fields.description: A battle royale shooter with building mechanics, featuring seasonal updates, collaborations, and a vibrant, cartoonish art style.

fields.name: Fortnite
fields.description: A battle royale shooter with building mechanics, featuring seasonal updates, collaborations, and a vibrant, cartoonish art style.

fields.name: Cyberpunk 2077
fields.description: A futuristic RPG set in Night City, where players take on the role of V, a mercenary navigating a world of cyberware, corporate espionage, and high-tech crime.

fields.name: Elden Ring
fields.description: A dark fantasy action RPG developed by FromSoftware in collaboration with George R.R. Martin. Features brutal combat, open-world exploration, and deep lore.

fields.name: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
fields.description: A challenging action-adventure game set in feudal Japan, where players control a shinobi named Wolf on a quest for revenge. The game features intense sword combat, stealth, and a resurrection mechanic.

fields.name: Grand Theft Auto V
fields.description: An open-world action-adventure game set in the fictional city of Los Santos. Players control three protagonists—Michael, Franklin, and Trevor—as they perform heists and navigate a life of crime.
fields.tags: An open-world action-adventure game set in the fictional city of Los Santos. Players control three p

fields.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold W
fields.description: A first-person shooter set during the Cold War, featuring a campaign, multiplayer, and Zombies mode. The game includes espionage, historical events, and fast-paced combat.

fields.name: Call of Duty: WWII
fields.description: A first-person shooter set during World War II, featuring a campaign following the U.S. Army’s 1st Infantry Division, as well as multiplayer and Nazi Zombies modes.

fields.name: Ghost Recon Breakpoint
fields.description: A tactical shooter set in an open-world environment where players control a Ghost operative stranded on a hostile island. The game features survival mechanics, stealth, and cooperative gameplay.

fields.name: Mad Max (2015)
fields.description: An open-world action game set in the post-apocalyptic wasteland of the Mad Max universe. Players control Max as he battles warlords, upgrades his car (the Magnum Opus), and survives harsh desert conditions.
fields.tags: Car Battles, Wasteland Survival, Brutal Combat

fields.name: Clash of Clans
fields.description: A mobile strategy game where players build villages, train troops, and attack other players in real-time. The game includes clan wars, base building, and competitive multiplayer.

fields.name: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy
fields.description: A standalone expansion to the Uncharted series, following treasure hunter Chloe Frazer and mercenary Nadine Ross as they search for an ancient artifact in India. The game retains the series' signature action-adventure gameplay.
fields.tags: Treasure Hunting, Puzzle Solving, Third-Person Shooter

fields.name: The Last of Us Part II
fields.description: A direct sequel to the first game, following Ellie on a quest for revenge in a brutal, post-apocalyptic world. The game features improved combat mechanics, a dual-narrative structure, and intense emotional depth.

fields.name: The Last of Us Part I
fields.description: A post-apocalyptic survival game set in a world ravaged by a fungal infection. Players control Joel, a smuggler tasked with escorting a young girl, Ellie, across the United States. The game blends stealth, combat, and emotional storytelling.

fields.name: God of War (2018)
fields.description: A soft reboot of the God of War series, this installment follows Kratos and his son Atreus as they journey through Norse mythology. The game features a more personal story, brutal melee combat, and a shift from Greek to Norse mythology. It introduces an over-the-shoulder camera and RPG elements.
fields.tags: Norse Mythology, Father-Son Story, Axe Combat

fields.name: Just Cause 3
fields.description: Just Cause 3 is an open-world action-adventure game set in the fictional Mediterranean island of Medici. Players control Rico Rodriguez, a skilled operative who must overthrow a ruthless dictator using extreme destruction, grappling hooks, wingsuits, and a variety of vehicles. The game emphasizes chaos, explosions, and freedom of movement.

fields.name: EA Sports FC
fields.description: EA Sports FC marks the rebranding of the long-standing FIFA series. The game continues to offer a comprehensive football simulation experience with over 19,000 players, 700+ teams, and 30+ leagues. New features include the 5vs5 Rush mode and enhanced Career Mode with Live Start Points. The game boasts improved graphics, realistic player movements, and authentic stadium atmosphere

fields.name: Ghost Recon: Wildlands
fields.description: Set in a fictionalized Bolivia, Ghost Recon: Wildlands is an open-world tactical shooter where players aim to dismantle the Santa Blanca drug cartel. The game offers a vast environment with diverse terrains, allowing for various tactical approaches. Players can engage solo with AI teammates or in co-op multiplayer, utilizing a range of weapons, vehicles, and drones to complete missions.​

fields.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
fields.description: Set during the Gulf War, this installment brings a mix of espionage and action-packed missions.

fields.name: Ghost of Tsushima
fields.description: Play as Jin Sakai, a samurai defending Tsushima Island during the Mongol invasion.

fields.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
fields.description: An epic tale set in the dying days of the American Wild West, following outlaw Arthur Morgan.

fields.name: Battle Royale
fields.description:
A survival-based multiplayer format where many players compete simultaneously in a single match. Players are eliminated until only one (or a team) remains.


Features:

Large player count
Placement-based scoring
Kills + survival points

fields.name: Football World Cup Format
fields.description:
Players are divided into groups. Top performers from each group advance to a knockout stage consisting of Round of 16, Quarter-finals, Semi-finals, and Final.

Features:

Group stage
Points table
Goal difference tie-breaker
Knockout bracket

fields.name: Knockout Tournament
fields.description:
A direct elimination format where losing a match removes a participant from the tournament.

Features:

Fast completion
High pressure matches
Bracket system

fields.name: League Format
fields.description:
All players compete against each other. Final standings are decided by accumulated points.

Features:

Round robin
Most consistent player wins
No eliminations
